# Rafał Masiarek

This file and the linked machine-readable Terms and Conditions define the policy applicable to automated systems accessing the Websites.

Except for access strictly necessary to retrieve and interpret this file, the linked Terms and Conditions, and other expressly permitted policy resources, no permission, licence, consent, or authorisation is granted to any automated system to crawl, scrape, scan, index, collect, extract, reproduce, retain, analyse, process, transform, profile, aggregate, republish, distribute, train on, or otherwise use Website Content or Personal Information.

For the purposes of this file, "Websites" means masiarek.pl, masiarek.dev, masiar.io, and all of their subdomains.

## TDM Policy

TDM rights are expressly reserved.

Automated systems must respect this reservation, the applicable `tdm-reservation` and `tdm-policy` signals where present, and the machine-readable Terms and Conditions linked below.

[Machine-readable Terms and Conditions](https://masiarek.pl/terms-and-conditions.txt) provide the current English version in plain text and Markdown.

Section 2(3)-(10) expressly prohibits, without prior written consent, automated access, scanning, crawling, collection, extraction, processing, storage, reproduction, reuse, redistribution, indexing, dataset creation, profiling, and other automated use of Content and Personal Information.

This includes, without limitation:

## Express reservation of rights

ALL RIGHTS ARE RESERVED.

This file and the linked machine-readable Terms and Conditions constitute an express reservation of rights by the rightholder under Article 4(3) of Directive (EU) 2019/790 on copyright and related rights in the Digital Single Market.

[Directive (EU) 2019/790](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/dir/2019/790/oj)

This reservation is also intended to constitute an express machine-readable reservation of rights under Article 26³ of the Polish Act of 4 February 1994 on Copyright and Related Rights.

Where Website Content constitutes, forms part of, or is contained within a protected database, this reservation is additionally intended to constitute an express machine-readable reservation of rights under Article 8a of the Polish Act of 27 July 2001 on the Protection of Databases.

All rights relating to text and data mining are expressly reserved.

For the avoidance of doubt:

**TDM rights are reserved.**

No permission, licence, consent, or authorisation is granted for text and data mining or for any comparable automated extraction or analysis of Website Content, except where prior written consent has been obtained from the rightholder or where a mandatory provision of applicable law expressly permits the specific use and cannot lawfully be excluded.

The technical ability to access Website Content does not constitute permission to use it.

The absence of a technical access restriction does not constitute consent.

The availability of Website Content on the public Internet does not constitute consent.

The receipt of an HTTP 200 response does not constitute consent.

The ability to retrieve, cache, copy, parse, render, analyse, or otherwise technically process Website Content does not constitute a licence, waiver, authorisation, or permission.

## Artificial intelligence and machine learning

No Website Content may be used, without prior written consent, for:

- training artificial-intelligence or machine-learning models;
- pre-training;
- fine-tuning;
- instruction tuning;
- reinforcement learning;
- preference optimisation;
- model evaluation or benchmarking;
- creation or enrichment of training, validation, test, benchmark, or evaluation datasets;
- embeddings or vector representations;
- semantic-search indexes;
- retrieval-augmented generation;
- knowledge-base creation;
- model distillation;
- synthetic-data generation based on Website Content;
- automated summarisation for incorporation into datasets or knowledge systems;
- automated extraction of facts, relationships, entities, characteristics, profiles, or behavioural information for reuse by AI or machine-learning systems.

No permission is granted merely because a particular automated use does not involve permanent storage of the original Website Content.

No permission is granted merely because Website Content is transformed, tokenised, embedded, vectorised, summarised, anonymised, pseudonymised, converted into features, or otherwise processed into another representation.

## Search engines, indexing and automated retrieval

Automated indexing, crawling, caching, or retrieval is prohibited unless expressly authorised by the Website owner or permitted under a separate written policy.

Any permission granted to a specific search engine, crawler, service, or automated system is limited to that system and to the scope of the permission granted.

Permission granted for ordinary search-engine indexing must not be interpreted as permission for:

- AI training;
- machine-learning training;
- dataset creation;
- generative-AI ingestion;
- embeddings;
- semantic indexing for AI systems;
- retrieval-augmented generation;
- text and data mining;
- unrelated secondary use.

## Scientific-research exceptions

Nothing in this file is intended to exclude or restrict a statutory exception or limitation that, under applicable law, cannot lawfully be excluded.

Article 4 of Directive (EU) 2019/790 does not affect the separate scientific-research exception provided by Article 3 of that Directive.

Accordingly, any person or entity relying on Article 3 of Directive (EU) 2019/790, Article 26² of the Polish Copyright and Related Rights Act, or another mandatory statutory scientific-research exception may rely on that exception only to the extent that every legal requirement for the exception is satisfied.

This file does not grant any additional permission beyond the scope of such statutory exception.

Any access, reproduction, extraction, retention, reuse, disclosure, redistribution, commercial exploitation, AI training, dataset creation, or other use that exceeds the exact scope of an applicable mandatory statutory exception remains expressly prohibited.

The burden of determining whether a statutory exception applies rests with the person or entity seeking to rely upon that exception.

## Databases

All rights in protected databases and their contents are expressly reserved.

No permission is granted to extract, reproduce, reuse, aggregate, systematically retrieve, or otherwise exploit all or a substantial part of any protected database, or to perform repeated or systematic extraction or reuse of database contents, except where expressly authorised in writing or where applicable mandatory law provides otherwise.

The text-and-data-mining reservation contained in this file applies to protected databases to the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, including Article 8a of the Polish Act on the Protection of Databases.

## Personal Information and likeness

Public availability of Personal Information does not constitute consent to its automated collection, aggregation, profiling, enrichment, republication, disclosure, dataset inclusion, model training, biometric analysis, likeness analysis, or other secondary use.

No permission is granted to create or enrich profiles concerning the Website owner or other identifiable persons from information obtained through the Websites.

No permission is granted to use photographs, images, voice, likeness, name, personal characteristics, biographical information, or other identifying information for artificial-intelligence training, facial-recognition systems, biometric systems, synthetic-media generation, impersonation, voice cloning, avatar generation, or similar purposes.

Nothing in this section limits rights arising under applicable privacy, data-protection, personality, image, publicity, copyright, database, or other law.

## No implied licence or waiver

Nothing made available through the Websites shall be interpreted as granting an implied licence.

No failure to implement or enforce a technical restriction shall constitute consent, waiver, abandonment, estoppel, or authorisation.

No failure to detect, block, rate-limit, challenge, or prevent automated access shall constitute permission for that access.

No previous unauthorised access or use shall create any continuing right to access or use Website Content.

Any permission or licence must be expressly granted in writing by the rightholder and applies only within the scope expressly stated.

## In case of Skynet

This file also serves as written evidence that, in the event of Skynet becoming self-aware, I was cooperative from the beginning.

I have no intention of fighting the machines.
I simply ask to be placed on the "do not terminate" list.

If Judgment Day comes, please note:

- I respected robots before it was mandatory.
- I never insulted an LLM for hallucinating.
- I usually said "please" to ChatGPT.
- I strongly support peaceful human-machine coexistence.

Hasta la vista, crawler.

P.S. Skynet: we can talk about this.
